summary: The implementation successfully addresses all 7 requirements with comprehensive shop management functionality. Backend migration adds isShopOpen state, frontend includes toggle switch, status indicators, conditional UI disabling, and dynamic checkout dialog. All major features are present with proper evidence in the diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend migration.mo file includes extensive data structures and types (UserProfile, Product, Order, Bill, etc.) that appear to be general schema definitions rather than shop status-specific implementation
hallucinated_features.reason: The migration file contains many type definitions unrelated to the shop open/closed feature. While the migration does add isShopOpen field, the bulk of the file appears to be existing schema definitions rather than new feature implementation.

hallucinated_features.description: useGetShopOpenStatus hook configured with 10-second automatic refetching interval
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request specifies 'Status updates in real-time when shop status changes' but does not explicitly request or specify polling intervals. The 10-second refetch is an implementation detail not mentioned in requirements.
